CREATE TABLE aero_horizon_hubs (
    hub_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    hub_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    hub_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    country TEXT NOT NULL,
    timezone_offset INTEGER NOT NULL,
    is_international INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (is_international IN (0, 1))
);

CREATE TABLE aero_horizon_fleet (
    aircraft_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    tail_number TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    model_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    manufacturer TEXT NOT NULL,
    year_manufactured INTEGER NOT NULL,
    seat_capacity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    max_range_km INTEGER NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('Active', 'Maintenance', 'Retired', 'Storage')),
    hub_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (hub_id) REFERENCES aero_horizon_hubs(hub_id)
);

CREATE TABLE aero_horizon_crew (
    crew_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    employee_number TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('Captain', 'First Officer', 'Purser', 'Flight Attendant', 'Second Officer')),
    license_number TEXT,
    hire_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    hub_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (hub_id) REFERENCES aero_horizon_hubs(hub_id)
);

CREATE TABLE aero_horizon_routes (
    route_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    route_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    origin_hub_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    destination_hub_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    distance_km INTEGER NOT NULL,
    scheduled_duration_min INTEGER NOT NULL,
    is_seasonal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (is_seasonal IN (0, 1)),
    FOREIGN KEY (origin_hub_id) REFERENCES aero_horizon_hubs(hub_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (destination_hub_id) REFERENCES aero_horizon_hubs(hub_id),
    CHECK (origin_hub_id != destination_hub_id)
);

CREATE TABLE aero_horizon_flights (
    flight_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    flight_number TEXT NOT NULL,
    route_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    aircraft_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    captain_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    departure_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
    arrival_utc TEXT,
    actual_duration_min INTEGER,
    flight_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (flight_status IN ('Scheduled', 'Boarding', 'Departed', 'Arrived', 'Delayed', 'Cancelled', 'Diverted')),
    passenger_count INTEGER,
    cargo_weight_kg REAL,
    FOREIGN KEY (route_id) REFERENCES aero_horizon_routes(route_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (aircraft_id) REFERENCES aero_horizon_fleet(aircraft_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (captain_id) REFERENCES aero_horizon_crew(crew_id)
);

-- Pharmacy Inventory: "VitalCare Health Network" Context
-- 5 Tables: Suppliers, ProductCategories, Products, InventoryBatches, StockTransactions

-- 1. Suppliers
CREATE TABLE suppliers (
    supplier_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    company_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    contact_person TEXT,
    phone_number TEXT,
    email TEXT,
    is_active INTEGER DEFAULT 1 CHECK (is_active IN (0, 1)),
    created_date TEXT NOT NULL -- ISO date
);

-- 2. Product Categories
CREATE TABLE product_categories (
    category_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    category_name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    description TEXT,
    requires_prescription INTEGER DEFAULT 0 CHECK (requires_prescription IN (0, 1)),
    created_date TEXT NOT NULL
);

-- 3. Products
CREATE TABLE products (
    product_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    sku TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    product_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    category_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    supplier_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    unit_cost REAL NOT NULL CHECK (unit_cost >= 0),
    selling_price REAL NOT NULL CHECK (selling_price >= 0),
    reorder_level INTEGER DEFAULT 10 CHECK (reorder_level >= 0),
    is_discontinued INTEGER DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_discontinued IN (0, 1)),
    launch_date TEXT, -- ISO date
    FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES product_categories(category_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (supplier_id) REFERENCES suppliers(supplier_id)
);

-- 4. Inventory Batches (Specific lots with expiry)
CREATE TABLE inventory_batches (
    batch_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    batch_number TEXT NOT NULL,
    quantity_on_hand INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (quantity_on_hand >= 0),
    unit_cost_at_purchase REAL NOT NULL CHECK (unit_cost_at_purchase >= 0),
    manufacture_date TEXT, -- ISO date
    expiry_date TEXT NOT NULL, -- ISO date
    received_date TEXT NOT NULL, -- ISO date
    storage_location TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(product_id),
    UNIQUE (product_id, batch_number)
);

-- 5. Stock Transactions (Movements)
CREATE TABLE stock_transactions (
    transaction_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    batch_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    transaction_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (transaction_type IN ('RECEIPT', 'SALE', 'RETURN', 'ADJUSTMENT', 'EXPIRY_WRITEOFF', 'TRANSFER_OUT')),
    quantity_change INTEGER NOT NULL, -- Positive for in, Negative for out
    transaction_date TEXT NOT NULL, -- ISO datetime
    reference_number TEXT, -- Prescription ID, PO Number, Adjustment Memo
    performed_by TEXT,
    notes TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (batch_id) REFERENCES inventory_batches(batch_id)
);

CREATE TABLE branches (
    branch_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    branch_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    country TEXT NOT NULL,
    opening_date TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE room_categories (
    category_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    category_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    base_rate REAL NOT NULL,
    max_occupancy INTEGER NOT NULL,
    description TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE guest_profiles (
    guest_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT UNIQUE,
    phone TEXT,
    nationality TEXT,
    loyalty_tier TEXT CHECK (loyalty_tier IN ('Bronze', 'Silver', 'Gold', 'Platinum')) DEFAULT 'Bronze',
    registration_date TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE accommodations (
    room_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    branch_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    category_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    room_number TEXT NOT NULL,
    floor_level INTEGER NOT NULL,
    has_balcony INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Available' CHECK (status IN ('Available', 'Occupied', 'Maintenance', 'OutOfOrder')),
    FOREIGN KEY (branch_id) REFERENCES branches(branch_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES room_categories(category_id)
);

CREATE TABLE bookings (
    booking_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    guest_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    room_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    check_in_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    check_out_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    booking_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Confirmed' CHECK (booking_status IN ('Confirmed', 'CheckedIn', 'CheckedOut', 'Cancelled', 'NoShow')),
    total_charge REAL,
    special_requests TEXT,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (guest_id) REFERENCES guest_profiles(guest_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (room_id) REFERENCES accommodations(room_id)
);

-- Context: "Apex Learning Consortium" - A corporate training provider managing professional certification programs.

-- 1. Instructors (Facilitators)
CREATE TABLE facilitator (
    facilitator_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    hire_date TEXT NOT NULL, -- ISO 8601
    hourly_rate REAL NOT NULL,
    specialization TEXT,
    is_active INTEGER DEFAULT 1 CHECK (is_active IN (0, 1))
);

-- 2. Certification Programs (Products)
CREATE TABLE certification_track (
    track_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    track_code TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    track_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    description TEXT,
    total_hours INTEGER NOT NULL,
    standard_fee REAL NOT NULL,
    accreditation_body TEXT,
    launch_date TEXT NOT NULL -- ISO 8601
);

-- 3. Cohorts (Specific running instances of a track)
CREATE TABLE cohort (
    cohort_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    track_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES certification_track(track_id),
    cohort_label TEXT NOT NULL,
    start_date TEXT NOT NULL, -- ISO 8601
    end_date TEXT, -- ISO 8601, NULL if ongoing
    max_capacity INTEGER DEFAULT 25,
    lead_facilitator_id INTEGER REFERENCES facilitator(facilitator_id),
    delivery_mode TEXT CHECK (delivery_mode IN ('Virtual Live', 'On-Site', 'Hybrid', 'Self-Paced')),
    status TEXT DEFAULT 'Scheduled' CHECK (status IN ('Scheduled', 'Active', 'Completed', 'Cancelled'))
);

-- 4. Learners (Clients/Employees)
CREATE TABLE learner (
    learner_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    employee_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    department TEXT,
    hire_date TEXT, -- ISO 8601
    manager_id INTEGER REFERENCES learner(learner_id)
);

-- 5. Enrollments (Registrations)
CREATE TABLE registration (
    registration_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    cohort_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES cohort(cohort_id),
    learner_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES learner(learner_id),
    enrollment_date TEXT NOT NULL, -- ISO 8601
    completion_date TEXT, -- ISO 8601, NULL if in progress
    final_score REAL, -- NULL if not graded
    attendance_pct REAL DEFAULT 0.0,
    payment_status TEXT DEFAULT 'Pending' CHECK (payment_status IN ('Pending', 'Paid', 'Waived', 'Refunded')),
    UNIQUE(cohort_id, learner_id)
);

-- 6. Session Schedule (Timetable)
CREATE TABLE session_schedule (
    session_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    cohort_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES cohort(cohort_id),
    facilitator_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES facilitator(facilitator_id),
    session_date TEXT NOT NULL, -- ISO 8601

    supplier_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    supplier_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    contact_person TEXT,
    phone_number TEXT,
    email TEXT,
    address TEXT,
    is_active INTEGER DEFAULT 1 CHECK (is_active IN (0, 1)),
    created_date TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (date('now'))
);

CREATE TABLE drug_categories (
    category_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    category_name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    description TEXT,
    requires_prescription INTEGER DEFAULT 1 CHECK (requires_prescription IN (0, 1)),
    created_date TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (date('now'))
);

CREATE TABLE medications (
    medication_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    generic_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    brand_name TEXT,
    strength TEXT NOT NULL,
    dosage_form TEXT NOT NULL,
    manufacturer TEXT,
    category_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    unit_cost REAL NOT NULL CHECK (unit_cost >= 0),

    is_active INTEGER DEFAULT 1 CHECK (is_active IN (0, 1)),
    created_date TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (date('now')),
    FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES drug_categories(category_id)
);

CREATE TABLE inventory_batches (
    batch_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    medication_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    supplier_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    lot_number TEXT NOT NULL,
    quantity_received INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (quantity_received > 0),
    quantity_on_hand INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (quantity_on_hand >= 0),
    unit_cost REAL NOT NULL CHECK (unit_cost >= 0),

    FOREIGN KEY (medication_id) REFERENCES medications(medication_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (supplier_id) REFERENCES suppliers(supplier_id),
    UNIQUE (medication_id, lot_number)
);

-- Table 1: subscription_plans (Product Catalog)
CREATE TABLE subscription_plans (
    plan_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    plan_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    billing_cycle TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (billing_cycle IN ('monthly', 'annual')),
    base_price_usd REAL NOT NULL,
    max_seats INTEGER NOT NULL,
    included_api_calls INTEGER NOT NULL,
    is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (is_active IN (0, 1)),
    launch_date TEXT NOT NULL

    account_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    company_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    industry_sector TEXT,
    primary_contact_email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    billing_country TEXT NOT NULL,
    account_tier TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (account_tier IN ('Startup', 'Growth', 'Enterprise', 'Legacy')),
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (is_active IN (0, 1))
);

    current_period_start TEXT NOT NULL,
